label: ZIIV Assess
title: Create once. Assess online.
intro: Build question banks, run exams online or on paper, grade objective answers automatically and publish accurate results, all in one place for schools.

modules.label: What’s inside
modules.title: Everything a school needs to teach, test and track progress.

items.name: Question bank
items.text: Reusable questions for every quiz, test and exam. Edits create new versions, so published exams never change.

items.name: Online or on paper
items.text: Deliver the same assessment in the browser with autosave and server-side timing, or print branded papers with separate marking schemes.

items.name: Automatic grading
items.text: Objective answers are marked instantly, with an auditable correction trail for every change.

items.name: Results & analytics
items.text: Class and question analytics after every assessment, with exportable results.

items.name: Lessons & homework
items.text: Notes, maths, videos and files students can read on any phone, plus homework with due dates.

items.name: Live classes & quizzes
items.text: Teach on Google Meet, Zoom or Teams with attendance recorded, or play a live quiz students join with a PIN.

items.name: Practice sets
items.text: Self-paced practice with instant feedback. Missed questions come back until they are mastered.

items.name: Chat & class groups
items.text: Class groups are created automatically, alongside private chats between staff and students.

codeLab.label: Code Lab
codeLab.title: Teach programming without installing anything.
codeLab.text: Students write and run code right in the browser, and coding questions can be set and marked inside assessments.
points: Coding questions in tests and homework

anywhere.label: Desktop and mobile
anywhere.title: Built for every phone in the classroom.
anywhere.text: Teachers manage everything from a laptop. Students read lessons, hand in homework and sit assessments from any phone.

cta.title: Bring ZIIV Assess to your school.
cta.text: Book a walkthrough and we’ll set it up around your classes, subjects and terms.
